title: The intrinsic coefficient/site square with bounded-below endpoints
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, phi:A→B a unital homomorphism, X and Y Noetherian schemes, j:X→Z an open immersion and p:Z→Y proper [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Use the recorded ordinary etale derived categories and intrinsic proetale realization [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, det-sp-reduction-exceptional]. Let M be a bounded-below ordinary etale A-complex on X, N a bounded-below ordinary etale B-complex on X, and a:M tensor_A^L B→N any morphism. Write U_R for reductionSite, F_R for the fixed etale compact-support functor, F_R^i for reductionCompactSupport, T for coefficient extension, delta for reductionSiteScalarIso, s_R for reductionSiteCompactSupportIso, q for the actual etale compactSupportMap and b for reductionDirectImageComparison [def-sp-reduction-direct-image-comparison, lem-pur-etale-compact-scalar-coherence]. Then T_Y(s_A(M));delta_Y(F_A M);U_B(q_M;F_B(a)) equals b_(U_A M);F_B^i(delta_X(M);U_B(a));s_B(N), in left-to-right composition order. No lower bound on T_X M is assumed.

proof.text: Unfold the realization scalar and compact-support comparisons. The scalar comparison is the inverse mate of the exact section-normalized restriction square; the proper direct-image comparison is fixed on K-injective representatives. Uniqueness of adjoints identifies these with the scalar and support presentations used for the recorded coefficient comparison. The exact open comparison cancels the same realization equivalences termwise.

Transpose the proper direct-image square using the bounded-below comparison-counit equations at the two endpoints. The scalar/pullback cube agrees on pure tensors, since the inverse scalar maps are mates of the sectionwise restriction square. Apply mate pasting and the triangle identities. This proves the proper mixed-endpoint square without inverting a comparison at the intermediate scalar extension. The exact open-extension comparison agrees termwise. Compose the proper and open squares, and use naturality to move the given map a through the B-support comparison. This yields the displayed equation, with the support comparisons evaluated only at M and N.

theorem reductionSiteCoefficientPasting
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p]
    (M : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} A) X)
    (hM : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus M)
    (N : Etale.DerivedCategoryModule (ULift.{u + 1, u} B) X)
    (hN : DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.plus N)
    (a : (Etale.scalarExtension (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) X).obj M ⟶ N) :
    let C : Compactification (j ≫ p) :=
      ⟨Z, p, j, rfl, inferInstance, inferInstance⟩
    (scalarExtensionFunctor φ Y).map
        ((reductionSiteCompactSupportIso A j p).hom.app ⟨M, hM⟩) ≫
      (reductionSiteScalarIso φ Y).hom.app
        ((Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} A)) C).obj M) ≫
      (reductionSite B Y).map
        (Etale.ExceptionalCoefficients.compactSupportMap
          (RingHom.ulift.{u + 1, u + 1, u, u} φ) C M ≫
          (Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactification
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) C).map a) =
    (reductionDirectImageComparison φ j p).app ((reductionSite A X).obj M) ≫
      (reductionCompactSupport B j p).map
        ((reductionSiteScalarIso φ X).hom.app M ≫ (reductionSite B X).map a) ≫
      (reductionSiteCompactSupportIso B j p).hom.app ⟨N, hN⟩
